summary: This is a routine proxy filing by ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd., a foreign private issuer, on Form 6-K to announce an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) scheduled for July 28, 2026. The meeting proposals are to approve a new compensation policy for directors and officers and to approve an employment agreement with a new President and CEO, Dr. Chen Lichtenstein. No event-driven deal terms, such as price per share or premium, are involved. This is a standard corporate governance update, not a special situation. The filing includes a notice, proxy statement, and proxy card. The board recommends voting FOR all proposals.
